newsitem.title: USA: Corning in Russia optical cable venture.
newsitem.headline: Corning in Russia optical cable venture.

text.p: Corning Inc said it and Russian telecommunications company Samara Cable Co Ltd have formed a joint venture, Samara Optical Cable Company, which will make optical fiber cables for telecommunication applications.
Terms of the venture were not disclosed.
Officials from Corning were not immediately available to comment further.
The venture, to be located in Samara, Russia, will sell the cables mainly in Russia, Corning said. The venture will use Corning optical fiber, Corning added.
Corning also said that its current and future customers in the area will continue to receive Corning fibers to meet their specifications.
